# Akhil Insights — Akhil Shibu (Data Analyst, Business Intelligence & Business Analyst)

> Akhil Shibu (also searched as Akhil and founder of Akhil Insights) is an Indian Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, and Business Analyst from Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. An MCA graduate from the University of Kerala (2026, CGPA 8.48), he specialises in SQL, Power BI, Microsoft Excel, Python, automated ETL data cleaning, and KPI dashboarding.

## Projects
- [Road Accident Analytics (2020–2025)](https://www.akhilinsights.com/projects/kerala-road-accident-analysis/) (Python, SQL, Power BI, Microsoft Excel, Pandas): Statistical investigation of 34,500+ traffic crash records across all 14 Kerala districts, pinpointing high-fatality districts and night-time risk.
- [DataSentrix: Data Analytics Platform](https://www.akhilinsights.com/projects/datasentrix/) (Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Pandas, ECharts, Matplotlib, API, SQLite): A web-based data analytics platform tested on a 200,000-row dataset with defined data cleaning rules, KPI metrics, charts and AI-assisted insights.
- [Bike Sales Analysis](https://www.akhilinsights.com/projects/bike-sales-dashboard/) (Microsoft Excel, Pivot Tables, Power Query, XLOOKUP, Slicers, KPI Cards): Cleaned Kaggle bike sales dataset and created an interactive Excel dashboard showing how commute distance, education and geography drive purchase behavior.

## Articles
- [How I analyzed Kerala road accident data with SQL window functions](https://www.akhilinsights.com/articles/kerala-road-accident-analysis-sql-window-functions/): Step-by-step: how a fresher data analyst ranked 14 Kerala districts by fatal crashes with SQL window functions, RANK() OVER and a time-of-day comparison.
- [How to build a Power BI dashboard from scratch](https://www.akhilinsights.com/articles/build-power-bi-dashboard-from-scratch/): A practical six-step guide to building a Power BI dashboard from scratch: KPIs, data cleaning, star schema, DAX measures, slicers and validation.
- [What skills does a data analyst fresher need?](https://www.akhilinsights.com/articles/data-analyst-fresher-skills-checklist/): The skills a data analyst fresher needs: Excel, SQL joins and CTEs, Power BI, Python, statistics and data storytelling, plus projects that prove them.
